# bintables/index

> Indexing with a bounds check; loads 1 or 8 bytes depending on the element type.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/index.pkg) · translates [std/index](../std/index.md)

The index is compared unsigned against the length, so negative indexes
fail the same check. A failed check jumps to `__pk_panic_index`.

- strings: the bytes start 8 bytes after the string's address;
- slices: the header's data pointer, then the element at `i × size`.

The `addr` sections give the element's address, for assignment and `&`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
{x}
push rax
{i}
pop rcx
cmp rax, [rcx]
jae __pk_panic_index
movzx eax, byte [rcx+rax+8]
@panic
```

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
{x}
push rax
{i}
pop rcx
cmp rax, [rcx+8]
jae __pk_panic_index
mov rcx, [rcx]
movzx eax, byte [rcx+rax]
@panic
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{x}
push rax
{i}
pop rcx
cmp rax, [rcx+8]
jae __pk_panic_index
mov rcx, [rcx]
mov rax, [rcx+rax*8]
@panic
```

### `emit addr when self size 1`

```nasm
{x}
push rax
{i}
pop rcx
cmp rax, [rcx+8]
jae __pk_panic_index
mov rcx, [rcx]
lea rax, [rcx+rax]
@panic
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
{x}
push rax
{i}
pop rcx
cmp rax, [rcx+8]
jae __pk_panic_index
mov rcx, [rcx]
lea rax, [rcx+rax*8]
@panic
```
